metadata:
  udi: prismata.tooling.manifest.tooling
  name: Tooling Manifest
  version: 1.0.0
  kind: manifest
  description: Versionable tooling and primitives manifest listing archived generators and active capability modules.

udi: prismata.tooling.manifest.tooling
kind: manifest

# Overrides marking archived generator implementations and pointing to archived originals
_archived_primitives:
  - udi: prismata.tooling.capability.apply-menu-templates
    archived: true
    module: generators/_archived_originals/apply_menu_templates.py
    notes: >
      Archived generator. Active deprecation stub remains at generators/apply_menu_templates.py.

  - udi: prismata.tooling.capability.validate-menu-actions
    archived: true
    module: generators/_archived_originals/validate_menu_actions.py
    notes: >
      Archived generator. Active deprecation stub remains at generators/validate_menu_actions.py.

  - udi: prismata.tooling.capability.replace-hardcoded-menus
    archived: true
    module: generators/_archived_originals/replace_hardcoded_menus.py
    notes: >
      Archived generator. Active deprecation stub remains at generators/replace_hardcoded_menus.py.

  - udi: prismata.tooling.capability.apply-action-stubs
    archived: true
    module: generators/_archived_originals/apply_action_stubs.py
    notes: >
      Archived generator. Active deprecation stub remains at generators/apply_action_stubs.py.

  - udi: prismata.tooling.capability.apply-action-stubs-auto
    archived: true
    module: generators/_archived_originals/apply_action_stubs_auto.py
    notes: >
      Archived generator. Active deprecation stub remains at generators/apply_action_stubs_auto.py.

  - udi: prismata.tooling.capability.compare-menu-templates
    archived: true
    module: generators/_archived_originals/compare_menu_templates.py
    notes: >
      Archived generator. Active deprecation stub remains at generators/compare_menu_templates.py.

  - udi: prismata.tooling.capability.menu-tree-tooling
    archived: true
    module: generators/_archived_originals/menu_tree_tooling.py
    notes: >
      Archived generator. Active deprecation stub remains at generators/menu_tree_tooling.py.

modules:
  - udi: prismata.universe.capability.auto-archive
    name: Auto-Archive Toggle
    version: 1.0.0
    module: Projects/Applications/Universe/src/capabilities/handlers.ts
    capability: prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-auto-archive
    description: >
      Toggles the auto-archive feature flag in Universe settings. When enabled,
      file-write operations (fs-create-from-object, fs-edit-vile) archive the
      previous file version to the Universe archive directory before overwriting.

  - udi: prismata.universe.capability.auto-versioning
    name: Auto-Versioning Toggle
    version: 1.0.0
    module: Projects/Applications/Universe/src/capabilities/handlers.ts
    capability: prismata.universe.capability.app-settings-auto-versioning
    description: >
      Toggles the auto-versioning feature flag in Universe settings. When enabled,
      fs-update-version reads the version field from selected YAML/JSON files and
      increments it using the shared versionUtil (remapVersion) forward/backward logic.
